meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 提供一套 PDF 处理脚本,可提取文本和表格、分析并填写表单、OCR 识别、合并拆分、验证文件完整性,输出 CSV、JSON 等格式。
howto.when: 当你需要处理复杂 PDF 流程、批量处理大量 PDF,或要求可靠的错误处理和校验时。

say.text: 用脚本分析这个 PDF 的表单字段,输出 JSON
say.note: 会调用 analyze_form.py 生成字段信息

say.text: 把这份报告里的表格提取成 CSV
say.note: 调用 extract_tables.py 自动识别表格

say.text: 把这几个 PDF 合并成一个文件
say.note: 调用 merge_pdfs.py 完成合并

howto.what_en: Provides a set of PDF processing scripts for extracting text and tables, analyzing and filling forms, OCR, merging and splitting PDFs, and validating files, with output to CSV, JSON, etc.
howto.when_en: When you need to handle complex PDF workflows, process many PDFs in batch, or require reliable error handling and validation.

say_en.text: Use the script to analyze this PDF's form fields and output JSON
say_en.note: Invokes analyze_form.py to generate field info

say_en.text: Extract the tables from this report into a CSV
say_en.note: Calls extract_tables.py for automatic table detection

say_en.text: Merge these PDFs into one file
